# Pinch yourself

Monthly Yearly

Essentials All the tools you need to start your business' digital journey Try Now Access Your Apps

*Your business will have to commit to purchase Zoho One licenses for ALL employees on payroll. For more details check the FAQs

## What you get

- Centralized administrative control
- Mobile device management
- Platform capabilities to build, customize, and extend

- 50+ unified business apps
- Industry-standard features
- Many apps, one simple invoice for your organization

## Let us help you with the initial personalization of your apps

The Zoho jumpstart team can help you. Starting at 11,000 MXN + taxes

## What you get

### Essentials

Get started with everything you need to launch your company's digital transformation. Our Essentials plan includes tools to boost your sales, customer service, marketing, project management, collaboration, and finances. Try Zoho One Essentials and discover why we are the operating system for businesses.

- All in one licencing model
- Central control of users and permissions
- Single invoice for all services
- 15+ unified business apps
- Industry-standard features
- Web and mobile apps, and additional elements included

### Standard

Get 50+ business applications designed to cover all areas of your company, advanced features to unify your team's management, AI-powered analytics and BI, a customization platform to meet your organization's specific needs, and more.

- Centralized administrative control
- Mobile device management
- Platform capabilities to build, customize, and extend
- 50+ unified business apps
- Industry-standard features
- Many apps, one simple invoice for your organization

Simplify how your entire business runs with Zoho One. One integrated application suite for one price, billed on one invoice. This high-impact approach to software—packing an incredible amount of technology into an impossible price—isn't new to Zoho. It's hardwired into our DNA.

...

- ### What editions are available in Zoho One?

We currently have two editions: Essentials, designed for companies starting their digitalization process, which includes all the necessary tools for a company to carry out all its sales, customer service, collaboration, marketing and finance functions smoothly.

...

When you start your free trial, you will have access to Zoho One's full potential for the duration of the trial. When the trial ends, you can decide whether to stay with the Essentials Plan or the Standard Plan.
- ### How much does Zoho One cost?

It depends on the plan and licensing model you choose:

Essentials: The Essentials plan costs per user per month with annual licensing.

Standard Plan, flexible users: The Zoho One standard plan costs per user per month with annual licensing. However, if you decide to purchase Zoho One licenses for all users in your organization, you might be eligible for the All-employees model.

Standard Plan, All-employees: If you decide to purchase Zoho One licenses for your entire team, you might be eligible for the Zoho One All-employees price, which is per user per month with annual licensing.

*Zoho One prices do not include VAT.
- ### What kind of support do you provide for setting up my Zoho apps?

In the Workplace suite, Zoho Mail and Zoho WorkDrive comply with HIPAA. We are working towards making our other apps compliant too.

## Zoho Workplace Pricing

Zoho Workplace pricing is determined by the customer's country, available currency, and billing frequency. Zoho Workplace paid plans are available with monthly and annual billing. Monthly billing shows the monthly subscription price. Annual billing shows the monthly equivalent price when the subscription is billed annually. Customers in supported countries are shown localized pricing when the corresponding currency is available. Countries without applicable localized pricing use USD or the applicable regional USD pricing.

Applicable local taxes, including VAT, GST, or similar taxes, are charged in addition to the prices displayed on the pricing page except AU and BR. AU and BR are inclusive of local taxes.
